description: DIXI Spec Kit: local SDD core in development.
lang: Language for messages and new documents.
init: Create a documentary baseline in a new or empty destination.
doctor: Diagnose local requirements without network or credentials.
check: Check structure and traceability without executing code.
directory: Destination directory; its parent must exist.
agent: Distributed integration: none (no agent) or claude (Claude Code commands).
structure_only: Scope: documentary structure. This does not certify application tests or readiness to build.
unsafe_path: Unsafe path, symbolic link, or access outside the permitted scope.
unsupported_platform: Platform lacks required safe filesystem operations; no unsafe fallback was used.
invalid_file: Invalid or nonregular file, or a read/analysis limit exceeded: {path}
destination_conflict: Destination is occupied or changed during the operation; files are not overwritten.
missing_project: Project metadata is missing. Run check from an initialized project root.
invalid_metadata: Invalid project metadata or incomplete inventory.
unsupported_schema: Schema or kit version is not supported by this installation.
invalid_trace: Invalid traceability graph: check types, unique IDs, and paths.
invalid_link: Invalid or unsafe local link in: {path}
resources_ok: Local resources available; safe filesystem operations available.
agent_none: Integration: none. No agent required. Project language: {language}
agent_claude: Integration: Claude Code. Installed commands: {commands}. Project language: {language}
no_project_optional: No project in this directory; general diagnosis completed.
invalid_arguments: Invalid arguments. See dixi --help; global options precede the command.
io_error: Input/output failure. Initialization may be partial; inspect the destination before retrying.
workflow: Consult procedures and prepare context without running an agent.
workflow_show: Show a procedure's inputs, steps, outputs and gates.
workflow_prepare: Prepare instructions and a target manifest; no writes or AI execution.
workflow_target: Exact ID of a compatible target in the graph.
workflow_request: Explicit request; up to 4,096 characters, without secrets.
workflow_scope: Scope: consultation or preparation. Does not execute the procedure, generate specs or certify approval or tests.
invalid_workflow_request: Request is empty, too long or contains unsupported characters.
invalid_workflow_target: Target ID is unknown or incompatible with this procedure.
workflow_context_limit: Context exceeds 64 sources or 2 MiB combined.
invalid_workflow_mode: MODE must contain mvp or prod.
workflow_no_next: Continue with human review and task planning; execution is not included yet.
